verses.geez: ወጸውዖሙ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለደቂቁ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ወኣይድዕክሙ ፡ [እንተ ፡] ትረክበክሙ ፡ በደኃሪ ፡ መዋዕል ።
verses.translation: And Jacob called his sons, and said to them, Assemble yourselves, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in the last days.

translations.lxx: And Jacob called his sons, and said to them, Assemble yourselves, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in the last days.
translations.kjv: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
translations.ron: Apoi a chemat Iacov pe fiii săi şi le-a zis: "Adunaţi-vă, ca să vă spun ce are să fie cu voi în zilele cele de apoi.
translations.grk: Ἐκάλεσε δὲ Ἰακὼβ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, συνάχθητε, ἵνα ἀναγγείλω ὑμῖν, τί ἀπαντήσει ὑμῖν ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμέρων.

verses.geez: ወተጋብኡ ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ስምዕዎ ፡ ለአቡክሙ ።
verses.translation: Gather yourselves together, and hear me, sons of Jacob; hear Israel, hear your father.

translations.lxx: Gather yourselves together, and hear me, sons of Jacob; hear Israel, hear your father.
translations.kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
translations.ron: Adunaţi-vă şi ascultaţi-mă, fiii lui Iacov, ascultaţi pe Israel, ascultaţi pe tatăl vostru!
translations.grk: Συνάχθητε, καὶ ἀκούσατέ μου, υἱοὶ Ἰακώβ· ἀκούσατε Ἰσραὴλ, ἀκούσατε τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ሩቤል ፡ በኵርየ ፡ ኀያል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወቀዳሜ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ወአግዘፈ ፡ ክሳዶ ፡ ወዕፁባተ ፡ ገብረ ።
verses.translation: Ruben, thou art my first-born, thou my strength, and the first of my children, hard to be endured, hard and self-willed.

translations.lxx: Ruben, thou art my first-born, thou my strength, and the first of my children, hard to be endured, hard and self-willed.
translations.kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
translations.ron: Ruben, întâi-născutul meu, tăria mea şi începătura puterii mele, culmea vredniciei şi culmea destoiniciei;
translations.grk: Ῥουβὴν πρωτότοκός μου, σὺ ἰσχύς μου, καὶ ἀρχὴ τέκνων μου, σκληρὸς φέρεσθαι, καὶ σκληρὸς αὐθάδης.

verses.geez:
ቈረረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዐ[ረ]ገ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምስካበ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወአርኰስኮ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ምስካብ ፡ ዘዲቤሁ ፡
                  ዐ[ረ]ገ ።
verses.translation: Thou wast insolent like water, burst not forth with violence, for thou wentest up to the bed of thy father; then thou defiledst the couch, whereupon thou wentest up.

translations.lxx: Thou wast insolent like water, burst not forth with violence, for thou wentest up to the bed of thy father; then thou defiledst the couch, whereupon thou wentest up.
translations.kjv: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
translations.ron: Tu ai clocotit ca apa şi nu vei avea întâietatea, pentru că te-ai suit în patul tatălui tău şi mi-ai pângărit aşternutul pe care te-ai suit.
translations.grk: Ἐξύβρισας ὡς ὕδωρ, μὴ ἐκζέσῃς, ἀνέβης γὰρ ἐπὶ τὴν κοίτην τοῦ πατρός σου· τότε ἐμίανας τὴν στρωμνὴν, οὗ ἀνέβης.

verses.geez: ስምዖን ፡ ወሌዊ ፡ አኀው ፡ ፈጸምዋ ፡ ለዐመፃ ፡ በቃሕዎሙ ፡ ወበኵናቶሙ ።
verses.translation: Symeon and Levi, brethren, accomplished the injustice of their cutting off.

translations.lxx: Symeon and Levi, brethren, accomplished the injustice of their cutting off.
translations.kjv: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
translations.ron: Fraţii Simeon şi Levi... Unelte ale cruzimii sunt săbiile lor.
translations.grk: Συμεὼν καὶ Λευὶ ἀδελφοὶ συνετέλεσαν ἀδικίαν ἐξαιρέσεως αὐτῶν·

verses.geez:
ነፍስየ ፡ ኢትትራከቦሙ ፡ ወኢይረድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሁከቶሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ በመዐቶሙ ፡ ቀተሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ወበፍትወቶሙ ፡ መተሩ ፡
                  ሥረዊሁ ፡ ለአህጉር ።
verses.translation: Let not my soul come into their counsel, and let not mine inward parts contend in their conspiracy, for in their wrath they slew men, and in their passion they houghed a bull.

translations.lxx: Let not my soul come into their counsel, and let not mine inward parts contend in their conspiracy, for in their wrath they slew men, and in their passion they houghed a bull.
translations.kjv: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
translations.ron: În sfatul lor să nu intre sufletul meu şi în adunarea lor să nu fie părtaşă slava mea, căci ei, în mânia lor, au ucis oameni şi, la supărarea lor, au ologit tauri!
translations.grk: Εἰς βουλὴν αὐτῶν μὴ ἔλθοι ἡ ψυχή μου, καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ συστάσει αὐτῶν μὴ ἐρίσαι τὰ ἥπατά μου· ὅτι ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτῶν ἀπέκτειναν ἀνθρώπους, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐνευροκόπησαν ταῦρον.

verses.geez:
ርጉመ ፡ ለይኩን ፡ መዐቶሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢገገጹ ፡ ቍጥዓሆሙ ፤ እከፍሎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወእዘርዎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: Cursed be their wrath, for it was wilful, and their anger, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

translations.lxx: Cursed be their wrath, for it was wilful, and their anger, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
translations.kjv: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
translations.ron: Blestemată să fie mânia lor, căci ea a fost silnică, şi aprinderea lor, căci a fost crudă; îi voi împărţi pe ei în Iacov şi îi voi risipi în Israel.
translations.grk: Ἐπικατάρατος ὁ θυμὸς αὐτὼν, ὅτι αὐθάδης· καὶ ἡ μῆνις αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐσκληρύνθη· διαμεριῷ αὐτοὺς ἐν Ἰακὼβ, καὶ διασπερῷ αὐτοὺς ἐν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ይሁዳ ፡ ሰብሑከ ፡ አኀዊከ ፡ እደዊከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዘባኖሙ ፡ ለጸላእትከ ፡ ይሰግዱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አቡከ ።
verses.translation: Juda, thy brethren have praised thee, and thy hands shall be on the back of thine enemies; thy father's sons shall do thee reverence.

translations.lxx: Juda, thy brethren have praised thee, and thy hands shall be on the back of thine enemies; thy father's sons shall do thee reverence.
translations.kjv: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.
translations.ron: Iudo, pe tine te vor lăuda fraţii tăi. Mâinile tale să fie în ceafa vrăjmaşilor tăi. Închina-se-vor ţie feciorii tatălui tău.
translations.grk: Ἰούδα, σὲ αἰνέσαισαν οἱ ἀδελφοί σου· αἱ χεῖρές σου ἐπὶ νώτου τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου· προσκυνήσουσί σοι οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ πατρός σου.

verses.geez:
ይሁዳ ፡ እጓለ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ እምሕዝአትከ ፡ ዕረግ ፡ ወልድየ ፤ ሰከብከ ፡ ወኖምከ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ወከመ ፡ እጓለ ፡
                  አንበሳ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘያነቅሀከ ።
verses.translation: Juda is a lion's whelp: from the tender plant, my son, thou art gone up, having couched thou liest as a lion, and as a whelp; who shall stir him up?

translations.lxx: Juda is a lion's whelp: from the tender plant, my son, thou art gone up, having couched thou liest as a lion, and as a whelp; who shall stir him up?
translations.kjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
translations.ron: Pui de leu eşti, Iudo, fiul meu! De la jaf te-ai întors... El a îndoit genunchii şi s-a culcat ca un leu, ca o leoaică... Cine-l va deştepta?
translations.grk: Σκύμνος λέοντος Ἰούδα· ἐκ βλαστοῦ, υἱέ μου, ἀνέβης· ἀναπεσὼν ἐκοιμήθης ὡς λέων καὶ ὡς σκύμνος· τίς ἐγερεῖ αὐτόν;

verses.geez:
ወኢይጠፍእ ፡ ምልእክና ፡ እምይሁዳ ፡ ወምስፍና ፡ እምአባሉ ፡ እስከ ፡ አመ ፡ ይረክብ ፡ ዘፅኑሕ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡
                  ተስፋሆሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ።
verses.translation: A ruler shall not fail from Juda, nor a prince from his loins, until there come the things stored up for him; and he is the expectation of nations.

translations.lxx: A ruler shall not fail from Juda, nor a prince from his loins, until there come the things stored up for him; and he is the expectation of nations.
translations.kjv: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
translations.ron: Nu va lipsi sceptru din Iuda, nici toiag de cârmuitor din coapsele sale, până ce va veni împăciuitorul, Căruia se vor supune popoarele.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐκλείψει ἄρχων ἐξ Ἰούδα, καὶ ἡγούμενος ἐκ τῶν μηρῶν αὐτοῦ, ἕως ἐὰν ἔλθῃ τὰ ἀποκείμενα αὐτῷ· καὶ αὐτὸς προσδοκία ἐθνῶν.

verses.geez:
የአስር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ወይን ፡ ዕዋሎ ፡ ወበዕፀ ፡ ዘይት ፡ አድጎ ፤ ወየኀፅብ ፡ በወይን ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወበደመ ፡
                  አስካል ፡ ሰንዱኖ ።
verses.translation: Binding his foal to the vine, and the foal of his ass to the branch of it, he shall wash his robe in wine, and his garment in the blood of the grape.

translations.lxx: Binding his foal to the vine, and the foal of his ass to the branch of it, he shall wash his robe in wine, and his garment in the blood of the grape.
translations.kjv: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
translations.ron: Acela îşi va lega de viţă asinul Său, de coardă mânzul asinei Sale. Spăla-va în vin haina Sa şi în sânge de strugure veşmântul Său!
translations.grk: Δεσμεύων πρὸς ἄμπελον τὸν πῶλον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τῇ ἕλικι τὸν πῶλον τῆς ὄνου αὐτοῦ, πλυνεῖ ἐν οἴνῳ τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν αἵματι σταφυλῆς τὴν περιβολὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ፍሡሓት ፡ እምወይን ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ፡ ወጸዐደ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐሊብ ፡ ስነኒሁ ።
verses.translation: His eyes shall be more cheering than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.

translations.lxx: His eyes shall be more cheering than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.
translations.kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
translations.ron: Ochii Lui vor scânteia ca vinul şi dinţii Săi vor fi albi ca laptele.
translations.grk: Χαροποιοὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ οἶνον· καὶ λευκοὶ οἱ ὀδόντες αὐτοῦ ἢ γάλα.

verses.geez: ዛቡሎን ፡ ሥኡኑ ፡ ይኅድር ፡ ከመ ፡ መርሶ ፡ አሕማር ፡ ወይስፋሕ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሲዶና ።
verses.translation: Zabulon shall dwell on the coast, and he shall be by a haven of ships, and shall extend to Sidon.

translations.lxx: Zabulon shall dwell on the coast, and he shall be by a haven of ships, and shall extend to Sidon.
translations.kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
translations.ron: Zabulon va locui lângă mare, va da liman corăbiilor şi marginea hotarului lui va fi până la Sidon.
translations.grk: Ζαβουλὼν παράλιος κατοικήσει καὶ αὐτὸς παρʼ ὅρμον πλοίων, καὶ παρατενεῖ ἕως Σιδῶνος.

verses.geez: ወይሳኮር ፡ ፈተዋ ፡ ለሠናይት ፡ ወያዐርፍ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ መዋርስት ።
verses.translation: Issachar has desired that which is good; resting between the inheritances.

translations.lxx: Issachar has desired that which is good; resting between the inheritances.
translations.kjv: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
translations.ron: Isahar este ca asinul voinic, care odihneşte între staule.
translations.grk: Ἰσσάχαρ τὸ καλὸν ἐπεθύμησεν, ἀναπαυόμενος ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κλήρων.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእያ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናይት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዕረፍት ፡ ወአትሐተ ፡ መትከፍቶ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትቀነያ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወጻመወ ፡
                  ወኮነ ፡ ሐረሳዌ ፡ ብእሴ ።
verses.translation: And having seen the resting place that it was good, and the land that it was fertile, he subjected his shoulder to labour, and became a husbandman.

translations.lxx: And having seen the resting place that it was good, and the land that it was fertile, he subjected his shoulder to labour, and became a husbandman.
translations.kjv: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
translations.ron: Văzând că odihna e bună şi ţinutul său gras, îşi pleacă umerii sub povară şi se face bărbat plătitor de bir.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν ἀνάπαυσιν ὅτι καλὴ, καὶ τὴν γῆν ὅτι πίων, ὑπέθηκε τὸν ὦμον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πονεῖν, καὶ ἐγενήθη ἀνὴρ γεωργός.

verses.geez: ዳን ፡ ይኴንን ፡ ሕዝቦ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ እምነገደ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: Dan shall judge his people, as one tribe too in Israel.

translations.lxx: Dan shall judge his people, as one tribe too in Israel.
translations.kjv: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
translations.ron: Dan va judeca pe poporul său, ca pe una din seminţiile lui Israel.
translations.grk: Δὰν κρινεῖ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, ὡσεὶ καὶ μία φυλὴ ἐν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
[*ይኩን ፡ ዳን ፡*] አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘይፀንሕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ ዘይነስኮ ፡ ሰኰናሁ ፡ ለፈረስ ፡ ወይወድቅ ፡
                  ዘይጼዐኖ ፡ ድኅሬሁ ።
verses.translation: And let Dan be a serpent in the way, besetting the path, biting the heel of the horse (and the rider shall fall backward),

translations.lxx: And let Dan be a serpent in the way, besetting the path, biting the heel of the horse (and the rider shall fall backward),
translations.kjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
translations.ron: Dan va fi şarpe la drum, viperă la potecă, înveninând piciorul calului, ca să cadă călăreţul.
translations.grk: Καὶ γενηθητω Δὰν ὄφις ἐφʼ ὁδοῦ, ἐγκαθήμενος ἐπὶ τρίβου, δάκνων πτέρναν ἵππου· καὶ πεσεῖται ὁ ἱππεὺς εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω,

verses.geez: ወይፀንሕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያድኅኖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: waiting for the salvation of the Lord.

translations.lxx: waiting for the salvation of the Lord.
translations.kjv: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
translations.ron: În ajutorul Tău nădăjduiesc, o, Doamne!
translations.grk: τὴν σωτηρίαν περιμένων Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ጋድ ፡ ፈ[የትዎ ፡ ፈያት ፡] ወውእቱሂ ፡ ፈ[የ]ቶሙ ፡ ተሊዎ ፡ አሰሮሙ ።
verses.translation: Gad, a plundering troop shall plunder him; but he shall plunder him, pursuing him closely.

translations.lxx: Gad, a plundering troop shall plunder him; but he shall plunder him, pursuing him closely.
translations.kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
translations.ron: Gad, strâmtorat va fi de cete înarmate, dar le va strâmtora şi el pas cu pas.
translations.grk: Γὰδ, πειρατήριον πειρατεύσει αὐτόν· αὐτὸς δὲ πειράτεύσει αὐτὸν κατὰ πόδας.

verses.geez: አሴር ፡ ጽጉበ ፡ እክል ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ሲሳየ ፡ ለመላእክት ።
verses.translation: Aser, his bread shall be fat; and he shall yield dainties to princes.

translations.lxx: Aser, his bread shall be fat; and he shall yield dainties to princes.
translations.kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
translations.ron: Din Aşer va veni pâinea cea grasă şi regilor le va da mâncăruri alese.
translations.grk: Ἀσὴρ, πίων αὐτοῦ ὁ ἄρτος· καὶ αὐτὸς δώσει τρυφὴν ἄρχουσι.

verses.geez: ንፍታሌም ፡ በቀልት ፡ ዕረፍት ፡ እንተ ፡ ትሤኒ ፡ አውፅአት ፡ እክለ ።
verses.translation: Nephthalim is a spreading stem, bestowing beauty on its fruit.

translations.lxx: Nephthalim is a spreading stem, bestowing beauty on its fruit.
translations.kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
translations.ron: Neftali, cerboaică slobodă: el rosteşte graiuri minunate.
translations.grk: Νεφθαλὶ στέλεχος ἀνειμένον, ἐπιδιδοὺς ἐν τῷ γεννήματι κάλλος.

verses.geez:
[ወል]ድ ፡ ዘይልህቅ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ዘይልህቀኒ ፡ ወዘይቀንእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ወሬዛ ፡ ዘይገብእ ፡
                  ኀቤየ ።
verses.translation: Joseph is a son increased; my dearly loved son is increased; my youngest son, turn to me.

translations.lxx: Joseph is a son increased; my dearly loved son is increased; my youngest son, turn to me.
translations.kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
translations.ron: Iosif, ramură de pom roditor, ramură de pom roditor lângă izvor, ramurile lui se revarsă peste ziduri.
translations.grk: Υἱὸς ηὐξημένος Ἰωσὴφ, υἱὸς ηὐξημένος μου ζηλωτὸς, υἱός μου νεώτατος· πρός με ἀνάστρεψον.

verses.geez: እለ ፡ ፀአልዎ ፡ በምክሮሙ ፡ ወኮንዎ ፡ አጋእስተ ፡ ወነደፍዎ ።
verses.translation: Against whom men taking evil counsel reproached him, and the archers pressed hard upon him.

translations.lxx: Against whom men taking evil counsel reproached him, and the archers pressed hard upon him.
translations.kjv: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
translations.ron: Îl vor amărî şi îl vor duşmăni; înspre el arunca-vor săgeţi şi îl vor sili la luptă.
translations.grk: Εἰς ὃν διαβουλευόμενοι ἐλοιδόρουν, καὶ ἐνεῖχον αὐτῷ κύριοι τοξευμάτων.

verses.geez:
ወተቀጥቀጠ ፡ አቅስቲሆሙ ፡ በኀይል ፡ ወደክመ ፡ ሥርወ ፡ መዝራዕተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ በእደ ፡ ኅይሉ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፤ በህየ ፡
                  አጽንዖ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ በኀበ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ለአቡከ ።
verses.translation: But their bow and arrows were mightily consumed, and the sinews of their arms were slackened by the hand of the mighty one of Jacob; thence is he that strengthened Israel from the God of thy father;

translations.lxx: But their bow and arrows were mightily consumed, and the sinews of their arms were slackened by the hand of the mighty one of Jacob; thence is he that strengthened Israel from the God of thy father;
translations.kjv: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
translations.ron: Dar arcul lui va rămâne tare şi muşchii braţului lui întăriţi, mulţumită Dumnezeului celui puternic al lui Iacov, Cel ce este păstorul şi tăria lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ συνετρίβη μετὰ κράτους τὰ τόξα αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐξελύθη τὰ νεῦρα βραχιόνων χειρὸς αὐτῶν, διὰ χεῖρα δυνάστου Ἰακώβ· ἐκεῖθεν ὁ κατισχύσας Ἰσραὴλ παρὰ Θεοῦ τοῦ πατρός σου.

verses.geez:
ወረድአከ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ ወባረከከ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ እምላዕሉ ፡ ወበረከተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  በእንተ ፡ በረከተ ፡ አጥባት ፡ ወመሓፅን ።
verses.translation: and my God helped thee, and he blessed thee with the blessing of heaven from above, and the blessing of the earth possessing all things, because of the blessing of the breasts and of the womb,

translations.lxx: and my God helped thee, and he blessed thee with the blessing of heaven from above, and the blessing of the earth possessing all things, because of the blessing of the breasts and of the womb,
translations.kjv: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
translations.ron: De la Dumnezeul tatălui tău, şi El te va ajuta; şi de la cel Atotputernic - El te va binecuvânta; de la El să vină binecuvântările, de sus din ceruri, şi binecuvântările adâncului de jos, binecuvântările sânilor şi ale pântecelui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐβοήθησέ σοι ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἐμὸς, καὶ εὐλόγησέ σε εὐλογίαν οὐρανοῦ ἄνωθεν, καὶ εὐλογίαν γῆς ἐχούσης πάντα, εἵνεκεν εὐλογίας μαστῶν καὶ μήτρας,

verses.geez:
በረከተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወእምከ ፡ ጽንዕት ፡ እምበረከቶሙ ፡ ለአድባር ፡ እለ ፡ ውዲዳን ፡ በበረከተ ፡ መላእክቲሁ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሀሉ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ወዲበ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ኮንዎ ፡ አኅዊሁ ።
verses.translation: the blessings of thy father and thy mother—it has prevailed above the blessing of the lasting mountains, and beyond the blessings of the everlasting hills; they shall be upon the head of Joseph, and upon the head of the brothers of whom he took the lead.

translations.lxx: the blessings of thy father and thy mother—it has prevailed above the blessing of the lasting mountains, and beyond the blessings of the everlasting hills; they shall be upon the head of Joseph, and upon the head of the brothers of whom he took the lead.
translations.kjv: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
translations.ron: Binecuvântările tatălui tău întrec binecuvântările munţilor celor din veac şi frumuseţea dealurilor celor veşnice. Aceste binecuvântări să fie pe capul lui Iosif, pe creştetul celui mai ales între fraţii lui.
translations.grk: εὐλογίας πατρός σου καὶ μητρός σου· ὑπερίσχυσεν ὑπὲρ εὐλογίας ὀρέων μονίμων, καὶ ἐπʼ εὐλογίαις θινῶν ἀενάων· ἔσονται ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν Ἰωσὴφ, καὶ ἐπὶ κορυφῆς ὧν ἡγήσατο ἀδελφῶν.

verses.geez: ብንያም ፡ ተኵላ ፡ መሣጢ ፡ ይበልዕ ፡ በነግህ ፡ ወፍና ፡ ሰርክ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ሱሳየ ።
verses.translation: Benjamin, as a ravening wolf, shall eat still in the morning, and at evening he gives food.

translations.lxx: Benjamin, as a ravening wolf, shall eat still in the morning, and at evening he gives food.
translations.kjv: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
translations.ron: Veniamin, lup răpitor, dimineaţa va mânca vânat şi pradă va împărţi seara".
translations.grk: Βενιαμὶν λύκος ἅρπαξ, τὸ πρωϊνὸν ἔδεται ἔτι, καὶ εἰς τὸ ἑσπέρας δίδωσι τροφήν.

verses.geez:
እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ ወዘንተ ፡ ነገሮሙ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ወባረኮሙ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ለለ
                  ፡ አሐዱ ፡ በከመ ፡ በረከቱ ፡ ባረኮሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ አሐዱ ።
verses.translation: All these are the twelve sons of Jacob; and their father spoke these words to them, and he blessed them; he blessed each of them according to his blessing.

translations.lxx: All these are the twelve sons of Jacob; and their father spoke these words to them, and he blessed them; he blessed each of them according to his blessing.
translations.kjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
translations.ron: Iată toate cele douăsprezece seminţii ale lui Israel şi iată ce le-a spus tatăl lor, când le-a binecuvântat şi a dat fiecăreia binecuvântarea cuvenită.
translations.grk: Πάντες οὕτοι υἱοὶ Ἰακὼβ δώδεκα· καὶ ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν· καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς· ἕκαστον κατὰ τὴν εὐλογίαν αὐτοῦ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አሐውር ፡ አንሰ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ወቅብሩኒ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በአት ፡ እንተ ፡
                  ሀለወት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገራህቱ ፡ ለኤፌሮን ፡ ኬጥያዊ ፤
verses.translation: And he said to them, I am added to my people; ye shall bury me with my fathers in the cave, which is in the field of Ephron the Chettite,

translations.lxx: And he said to them, I am added to my people; ye shall bury me with my fathers in the cave, which is in the field of Ephron the Chettite,
translations.kjv: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
translations.ron: Apoi le-a poruncit: "Eu am să trec la poporul meu. Să mă îngropaţi lângă părinţii mei, în peştera din ţarina lui Efron Heteul.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, ἐγὼ προστίθεμαι πρὸς τὸν ἐμὸν λαόν· θάψτέ με μετὰ τῶν πατέρων μου ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ Ἐφρὼν τοῦ Χετταίου,

verses.geez:
ውስተ ፡ በአተ ፡ ካዕበት ፡ እንተ ፡ አንጻረ ፡ ምንባሬ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሣየጠ ፡ አብርሃም ፡
                  በኀበ ፡ ኤፌሮን ፡ ኬጥያዊ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሣየጠ ፡ ለመቃብር ።
verses.translation: in the double cave which is opposite Mambre, in the land of Chanaan, the cave which Abraam bought of Ephron the Chettite, for a possession of a sepulchre.

translations.lxx: in the double cave which is opposite Mambre, in the land of Chanaan, the cave which Abraam bought of Ephron the Chettite, for a possession of a sepulchre.
translations.kjv: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
translations.ron: În peştera din ţarina Macpela, în faţa lui Mamvri, în pământul Canaan, pe care a cumpărat-o Avraam de la Efron Heteul, împreună cu ţarina, ca moşie de înmormântare.
translations.grk: ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ τῷ διπλῷ, τῷ ἀπέναντι Μαμβρῆ, ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν, ὃ ἐκτήσατο Ἁβραὰμ τὸ σπήλαιον παρὰ Ἐφρὼν τοῦ Χετταίου ἐν κτήσει μνημείου.

verses.geez:
ህየ ፡ ቀበርዎሙ ፡ [ለአብርሃም ፡ ወለሳራ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ወህየ ፡ ቀበርዎሙ ፡] ለይስሐቅ ፡ ወለርብቃ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ወህየ
                  ፡ ቀበርዋ ፡ ለልያሂ ፤
verses.translation: There they buried Abraam and Sarrha his wife; there they buried Isaac, and Rebecca his wife; there they buried Lea;

translations.lxx: There they buried Abraam and Sarrha his wife; there they buried Isaac, and Rebecca his wife; there they buried Lea;
translations.kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
translations.ron: Acolo au fost îngropaţi Avraam şi Sarra, femeia sa, acolo au fost îngropaţi Isaac şi Rebeca, femeia lui, şi tot acolo am îngropat şi eu pe Lia.
translations.grk: Ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν Ἁβραὰμ καὶ Σάῤῥαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ· ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ῥεβέκκαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ· ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν Λείαν·

verses.geez: ውስተ ፡ በአተ ፡ ገራህት ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሣየጡ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኬጢ ።
verses.translation: in the portion of the field, and of the cave that was in it, purchased of the sons of Chet.

translations.lxx: in the portion of the field, and of the cave that was in it, purchased of the sons of Chet.
translations.kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
translations.ron: Această ţarină şi peştera din ea au fost cumpărate de la feciorii Heteilor".
translations.grk: Ἐν κτήσει τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ τοῦ σπηλαίου τοῦ ὄντος ἐν αὐτῷ, παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Χέτ.

verses.geez:
ወአኅለቀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ አዝዞቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቁ ፡ ወሰፍሐ ፡ እገሪሁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምስካቢሁ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝቡ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Jacob ceased giving charges to his sons; and having lifted up his feet on the bed, he died, and was gathered to his people.

translations.lxx: And Jacob ceased giving charges to his sons; and having lifted up his feet on the bed, he died, and was gathered to his people.
translations.kjv: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
translations.ron: Sfârşind Iacov poruncile sale, pe care le-a dat feciorilor săi, şi întinzându-şi picioarele sale în pat, şi-a dat sfârşitul şi s-a adăugat la poporul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέπαυσεν Ἰακὼβ ἐπιτάσσων τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐξᾴρας τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην, ἐξέλιπε· καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.
